ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is right triangle ABC, A is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, and B is directly above C; AC is the horizontal base and is labeled 12, BC is the vertical side and is labeled 5, and angle C is a right angle. Then reason: according to the coordinate method, take A=(0,0), C=(12,0), B=(12,5). Let the radius of the semicircle be r, then the center of the semicircle is at the midpoint of the diameter, and the right endpoint is C, so the center O=(12-r,0). Hypotenuse AB passes through (0,0) and (12,5), and its equation is y=(5/12)x, that is, 5x-12y=0. Because the arc is tangent to AB, the distance from the center O to line AB equals r. The distance is |5(12-r)-12·0|/sqrt(5^2+(-12)^2)=5(12-r)/13. Let 5(12-r)/13=r, obtaining 60-5r=13r, so 18r=60, r=10/3.

raw_record.question_text: In the right triangle $ABC$, $AC=12$, $BC=5$, and angle $C$ is a right angle. A semicircle is inscribed in the triangle as shown. What is the radius of the semicircle?

method.method_draft: Use coordinate geometry. From the image, take A=(0,0), C=(12,0), and B=(12,5), since AC is the horizontal leg and BC is the vertical leg. The semicircle has its diameter on AC, with its right endpoint at C; if its radius is r, its center is O=(12-r,0). The arc is tangent to the hypotenuse AB, so the perpendicular distance from O to line AB equals r. From the text, AC=12 and BC=5, so AB has equation y=(5/12)x, or 5x-12y=0. Then distance from O to AB is 5(12-r)/13. Set 5(12-r)/13=r and solve to get r=10/3.

method.method_draft: Use similar right triangles. From the image, let O be the center of the semicircle on AC and T be the tangency point where the semicircle touches AB. The radius OT is perpendicular to AB. If the radius is r, then OC=r and AO=12-r because C is the right endpoint of the semicircle’s diameter. Triangle AOT is right at T and shares angle A with triangle ABC, so triangle AOT is similar to triangle ABC. From the text, ABC is a 5-12-13 right triangle, so AB=13. In the similarity, OT corresponds to BC and AO corresponds to AB, giving r/(12-r)=5/13. Solve to obtain r=10/3.
